Company Handbook

Our company, Northstar Technologies, develops software products for business customers. The standard working week is Monday through Friday. Employees normally work eight hours per day. The company provides employees with access to internal training programs. Employees should discuss training plans with their manager before enrolling. The company observes public holidays according to the employee's work location.

Office and Conduct

Employees are expected to communicate respectfully with colleagues and customers. Company equipment must be used primarily for business purposes and handled with reasonable care. Employees should report security incidents or suspected loss of company information to the IT team as soon as possible.

The project named Aurora was created by Dr. Maya Chen in 2024. Aurora was designed to help researchers analyze climate data. The project uses Python for its data processing pipeline. The initial version was developed at the Northstar Research Lab. Aurora is currently used by several research teams for climate analysis.

Leave Policy

Full-time employees receive 24 days of annual leave per calendar year. Employees should submit annual leave requests at least 3 working days before the requested leave date. Managers are responsible for reviewing and approving leave requests. Unused annual leave may be carried forward for up to 5 days into the following calendar year. Sick leave should be reported to the employee's manager as soon as reasonably possible.

Parental Leave

Employees should contact Human Resources for information about parental leave eligibility and the applicable leave period. Parental leave requests should be submitted through the company's HR system.

Expense Reimbursement Policy

Employees may request reimbursement for reasonable business expenses incurred while performing approved company activities. Expense claims should normally be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Receipts are required for individual expenses of 25 dollars or more. Travel expenses must comply with the approved travel plan and applicable spending limits. Managers review expense claims before reimbursement is processed.

Travel

Employees should use economy-class air travel for flights shorter than 6 hours unless an exception has been approved. Hotel expenses must remain within the nightly limit specified by the approved travel plan. Personal expenses are not eligible for reimbursement.

Remote Work Policy

Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to team requirements. Remote work schedules should be agreed with the employee's manager in advance. Employees working remotely are expected to remain reachable during their agreed working hours. Company data must only be accessed using approved devices, applications, and security controls.

Remote Equipment

Employees may request an approved company laptop and monitor for remote work. Equipment requests should be submitted to the IT service desk. Employees are responsible for taking reasonable care of company equipment used at home.
